Brief 011 · HUD round 2: direction A through the Handover (stopped)

Direction A, enamel docked, drawn through the whole Handover: one frame per beat, the Codex image tool for every panel, laid over Latch's honest play-zoom plates with a drawn world layer (rings, tags, cones, routes, cell capsules). The three runs follow the rulebook's numbers.

Status: stopped. Sky's verdict on this round was "way too complicated"; round 3 is the minimal, in-world HUD (../round3/index.html). Only part 1 was drawn; the card states, variations and wild alternatives are written up as prompts but not drawn.

Part 1 · the Handover, one frame per beat
Honest limits. The plates carry no cell capsules or vehicles: the cell, the patrol officer and the car footprints are drawn by the world layer. The driver and guard are placeholders (M-2 casts neither yet). The Codex timelines are not to scale (a playhead can sit on the wrong tick). Strings were checked by eye against the prompts, not by OCR.

Part 1 · the Handover, one frame per beat

Run 1 pays blind and stays quiet; run 2 is found and goes loud; route B turns the driver.

01Briefing, 0:00, pausedall runs

0:00 · the briefing sheet over a paused street

Tactical pause is on by default, so the mission opens paused: the clock window and pause button carry a turquoise ring and a Paused tag. The sheet holds only what the briefing gives: known events solid, the rivals' 3:10 and the waitress's debt hatched as suspected. Purse $100,000, closing event 8:00.

02First order, queued while pausedrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

0:00 · Inez clicked, Scout's Watch queued while paused

Orders given while paused queue as dotted turquoise bars on the timeline and a dotted route; they start on resume. Pay, Help and Pressure show their price but stay locked (Watch first, Listen first); Need is half-filled: suspected from the briefing.

03Scout watching Inezrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

0:20 · the picked frame: Scout Watch 0:32 in progress

Direction A as picked, now over an honest play-zoom plate. Nothing is learned, so every outcome is a dotted ring with a question mark; the Scout tab counts down its Watch.

04After Watch: Pay unlocked, but "?"run 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

0:58 · routine known; Pay is unlocked and still a gamble

Watch gave routine only: the Routine chip is ticked, Need stays half (briefing), Temperament is still a ring. Pay's row lights up with its outcome a question mark and the note "Listen to learn if she takes a bribe"; Help and Pressure stay locked until Listen. Listen is planned (dotted).

05Pay attempted and refusedrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

1:54 · the blind Pay is refused and remembered

The $70,000 is kept (struck on the row) but 50 s and +2 T are paid; Trail 2, early. The refusal taught the cell her temperament (Idealist) but not her need, so Help and Pressure show real outcomes yet stay locked. Every later offer carries the remembered refusal: Help is now $50,000 and +2 T, Pressure +5 T.

06Listen done: need confirmed, Help shows its outcomerun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

2:40 · the debt is confirmed; Help hovered, with its line items

Listen turned "In debt (briefing)" into a known fact (heard 2:38). Help is the one row that works: $50,000, +2 T. The line-item popover itemises it (base, +$10,000 +1 T refused before, walk, "if seen" hatched) and the 13 m ring shows who would see it, including the patrol officer.

07Help confirmed: Inez turnedrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

3:38 · Inez is a contact; the Fixer's card becomes a Call

Cash $50,000, Trail 5 (a patrol officer at 11 m saw the debt cleared: +1) and the first Alert lamp lit, "Inquiry". The file gets a Contact badge and the card switches to Fixer · Call with the "Turn" rows retired. 3:10 has passed (solid tick); Next event now points at the 5:30 chime.

08Tech loops the entrance camerarun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

4:05 · Loop holds the entrance camera; the Tech is tethered

The same card on a camera: Tech · Loop $0, 62 s, +1 T, with the walk and the 8 m tether in the note. The blinded cone is drawn as a dotted outline (a live cone is a red hatched wedge); the Tech tab says "tethered". The timeline grows four lanes, one per operative, with every planned order dotted.

09Fixer calls Inez on cue: the door windowrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

4:52 · the Call lands; the guard walks; the 2:30 window opens

The door card lists who sees the door now and when each stops, then prices the Enforcer's Enter against it. A draining 2:30 window sits on the card, the timeline and in the street; the guard's amber route marches off to the café. Trail 7 (Loop +1, Call +1).

10Enforcer enters and takes Valerun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

5:44 · Take Vale: the Enforcer is inside, an off-screen action

Interiors are timed off-screen actions: the tab says "inside" and the banner counts the 0:21 left. Vale's file holds what the cell knows (his routine) and rules (a councillor is never an Idealist). The card prices Take (+2 T, unturned) and shows Fire as "Fails now": shooting the target ends the attempt.

11Route B: the driver, before 5:40route B: the driver

2:12 · the driver's card; turning him before 5:40 moves the pickup

Same dossier and card for a second person: an Idealist driver who needs cash, so Help works at $40,000 and Pay is refused. The "last chance 5:40" flag on the timeline, and the ghost of the pickup moving to the service lane in the street. (Driver cast is a placeholder: M-2 casts no driver yet.)

12Route B: the pickup movedroute B: the driver

3:06 · the driver is turned; the pickup is now the service lane

The result drawn where it happens: a turquoise pickup footprint on the service lane, the old bay struck on the file's Pickup strip, and a dotted violet footprint for the rivals' 3:10 car. The "last chance" flag is ticked.

13Alert 0 to 1: a witness reportrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

3:40 · Alert 1, inquiry: a patrol officer reported the payment

The Alert window opens into a four-step ladder, the incident that raised it (who, how far, what), the response unit state and the hatched seal rule. Alert never falls within a mission.

14Alert 1 to 2: a found faultrun 2: the loop is found, loud

5:12 · Alert 2, search: a watcher found the looped feed

Second incident, new row on the Alert card, third lamp lit, the response unit's route and arrival drawn on the street, and the seal clock hatched (it starts only when the unit arrives). A quiet route ends here: Alert 2 makes the final fight loud.

15Trail rising: why is the investigation active?run 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

5:20 · Trail 7, active, with the named cause and one line per Trail point

The answer to T3's question is always on screen: the state word, the named cause (who can name the Fixer), and the ledger, one row per point with its act and time. Hatched row: what Take would add. The street shows the investigator with its questioning icon and a dotted line joining the leads it holds.

16Final fight, safe branch: rivalsrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

6:02 · no shots, Alert 1: rivals ambush, the guard fights them

The fight panel names who helps and why (the guard never saw you, Inez warned you 10 s early), counts the hostiles with their health pips, measures the rivals' distance to Vale, and prices Fire with its consequence: "any shot makes this fight loud".

17Final fight, loud branch: policerun 2: the loop is found, loud

6:08 · shots fired, Alert 3: police from the west street, the seal clock running

Same panel, loud state: officers (amber shields) with their arrival time, rivals still alive, no allies, a dot-matrix seal clock, and the price of each shot (+2 T, +1 A). The lamp column is at three.

18Next event jumpingrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

2:48 · running fast to 3:10

The button is pressed and ringed, the clock digits go turquoise with a fast chip, and a dotted arrow jumps from the playhead to the next tick. The right panel lists what the jump will stop at, including the stop rules (an order finishing, any Alert or Trail change) and the tactical-pause switch.

19Group selection: a move across the roadrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

0:12 · Shift-select Fixer + Tech, click across Apron Road

Two tabs outlined and bracketed as "Group 2 + 3"; the verb strip shows the union of their verbs. The path goes straight over the carriageway, not to a crossing, and the card says what it costs: nothing. Crossing a road adds no Trail or Alert.

20Win: Vale at the getaway carrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

6:34 · Vale alive at the getaway car

A result sheet with the five numbers that matter (time and margin, Trail, Alert, cash, standing) and two buttons: Debrief and Replay. The tray and bar stay so the player can still read the final state.

21Fail: the district sealedrun 2: the loop is found, loud

7:55 · the district sealed

The fail sheet names the cause and the three moments that led to it (the found feed, the response unit, the seal), then offers Replay from a checkpoint, Replay from the start, or Continue. Replay is free until Continue; after that the result stands (§08).

22Debrief: what happened, what the next mission inheritsrun 1: route A, pays blind, quiet

After 6:34 · two sheets: what happened to the people, and what carries over

Left: every change with its cause, one line each (turned by Help, bravery helper to accomplice, remembers the Fixer, a new need told free, an introduction). Right: what the next mission inherits (cash, Trail, Heat, standing, investigation state, contacts, health).
